newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - NYMEX crude looks to overcome $20.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - NYMEX crude looks to overcome $20.

text.p: NEARBY MONTH CLOSE * SUPPORT * RESIST * RSI-14 * MA-10 * MA-20
+ NYMEX crude rose above the important $20.00 level on Thursday but failed to sustain this, settling at $19.99, and this may again prove a hard level to break through on Friday.
+ Resistance above here will firstly be encountered at $20.24 and then $20.40, while support will be felt at $19.50.

NYMEX crude oil futures were expected to face resistance at around Thursdsay's close if the market opens below $19.99, technical analysts said on Friday. If it opens higher, then that level would be supportive.

August crude rose 34 cents a barrel on Thursday and ended at $19.99 after trading as high as $20.24. August gasoline was 1.43 cents a gallon up at 61.89 cents, while heating oil was 1.21 cents up at 53.89 cents.
A Washington-based analyst was bearish in the short term and pegged support at $19.50. She said the failure to sustain the move above $20.00 a tonne on Thursday was a sign of weakness.
But in the slightly longer term, prices could head higher, she said, with resistance first at Thursday's high of $20.24 and then important resistance at $20.39/$20.40.
These numbers correspond approximately to the highs formed earlier this month.
But looking at the wider picture, she said she thought prices may have stopped falling.
"There is some evidence that we could be in some kind of bottoming pattern. My daily charts have now turned up and my weeklies are trying to give me a buy signal.
Fenella Graham at MeesPierson Derivatives in London, employing the market Profile technique, also placed resistance at $20.24 and $20.40, although suggesting a nearer layer would be found at $20.16.
She said in her daily report that gasoline would find support at 61.30, 61.00 and 60.70 cents, while resistance would appear at 62.40, 62.70 and 63.40.
